vulnerability_summary: prek-action interpolated attacker-controlled action inputs directly into composite-action shell scripts, enabling command injection.
causality: GitHub Copilot SWE agent atomic commit 070aae8e added the prek-version input and directly interpolated the input expression into a bash condition and python -m pip install prek==... command. That exact input is one of the three injection vectors named by the advisory. The bot-authored squash a7c5a005 published the same vulnerable feature. Fix 6b7c6ef5 moved prek-version into the PREK_VERSION environment variable and removed expression interpolation from shell code. The advisory also covers older extra_args sinks, while the independently sufficient prek-version vector has an atomic AI-authored origin.

evidence.atomic_binding: 070aae8e adds both the attacker-controlled prek-version input and its direct shell interpolations; 6b7c6ef5 replaces those interpolations with env.PREK_VERSION.
